acceptance.item: Gate G6 run 1 failure, T12.spec.ts:1242 'a link to C8 node 7 (1024 positions) hydrates without a long task' (no finding id; P6-RT-07-04 was refuted and is listed only for its evidence)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts > regressions > a link is read in a task after the hydration task, the tool frozen meanwhile, and a link the back button loads before it is the one shown; and the unchanged site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts:1242 long-task tests
acceptance.evidence: Cause: the hydration $effect ran readLink and load(state) inside the island's hydration task, so for a link that task held both the hydration of the server markup and the re-render to the link's state, with the engine facts of its node. Fix (3bd9069): when the address holds a key of the instance's form, the effect freezes the tool (linkPending, read by frozen), counts one drawing run (data-drawn='false'), and reads the link in a setTimeout task of its own. That task calls readLink and then activate as before, and is dropped if a popstate load changed the generation. Addresses without such a key take the old path unchanged. Red at base: at hydration the base showed D4 node 2 with the picker enabled. Green: 4 passed. Measured true task lengths (trace, RUNS=9 alternated, load 21 to 25): C8:7 45.3 to 23.0 ms, E7:7 44.5 to 21.9 ms, no link 25.4 to 24.2 ms. The link's hydration task is now the same length as a page without a link. Counts for --repeat-each 20 --workers 1: base 80 of 80 at load 6 to 1, and 73 of 80 at load 1 to 28 (7 failures; 52 of 240 case tasks and 59 of 240 control tasks were long). Fix: 80 of 80 at load 17 to 31 (9 of 240 and 17 of 240 long). The test is still marginal under heavy contention: the remaining long tasks are the hydration of the server markup itself (about 22 to 25 ms at quiet load) when the load is 5 to 8 times the 4 processors. The test, its limits and its throttling are unchanged.
